title: Compile physical parameters
action: Gather or compute the required input parameters for each metal and crystal face: Wigner‑Seitz radius r_s (a.u.), Ashcroft empty‑core radius r_c (a.u.), crystal structure (bcc/fcc/hcp), and interplanar spacings d (a.u.) for the (110), (100), (111), and (0001) faces. These are publicly known constants.
description: Collect all physical constants needed for the variational calculations.

title: Variational surface energy and work function calculation
action: Implement the seven-component surface-energy functional (kinetic, electrostatic, LDA exchange‑correlation, wave‑vector nonlocal exchange‑correlation correction, Ashcroft pseudopotential, classical cleavage, short‑range repulsive) and the linear‑potential model trial density. For each metal and face, minimize the LDA surface energy with respect to the variational parameter y_F using numerical optimization. From the minimizing density evaluate the final surface energy (LDA and with wave‑vector correction) and compute the DPΔSCF work function.
description: Core numerical pipeline that produces surface energies and work functions for all 39 metal‑face combinations.

title: Write surface energies table
action: Write the computed surface energies to /app/outputs/surface_energies.json. Each entry includes metal, face, y_F, LDA_surface_energy (ergs/cm²), and corrected_surface_energy (ergs/cm²). Cover all combinations from the original Table I.
description: JSON array of computed surface energies (LDA and corrected) and optimized variational parameters for all 12 metals and their low‑index faces.
output_schema: Array of objects with fields: metal (string), face (string), y_F (number), LDA_surface_energy (number), corrected_surface_energy (number)

title: Write work functions table
action: Write the computed DPΔSCF work functions to /app/outputs/work_functions.json. Each entry contains metal, face, Phi_DPDeltaSCF (eV). Include all entries from the original Table II’s Φ^DPΔSCF column.
description: JSON array of DPΔSCF work functions for all required metal‑face combinations.
output_schema: Array of objects with fields: metal (string), face (string), Phi_DPDeltaSCF (number)
